fields.name: Chapman Zone
fields.hypothesis: Structural mapping and geochemical sampling indicate a shear-hosted gold mineralisation system associated with the regional fault corridor. Elevated Iron Ore values in rock chips and soils define a 1.7 km trend with anomalous pathfinder elements suggestive of a significant discovery.
fields.objective: The primary objective is to confirm continuity of the high-grade shoot identified in Phase 1 and establish an inferred resource base sufficient to support a maiden drilling programme. Secondary objective: assess metallurgical recovery potential for Iron Ore.
